quest.title: The Chef's Tale
quest.description: Listen to the ghosts' whispers and retrieve their names.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Hey, newbie. You can't be making food like that.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: We're making rations for the Ratniki on the island, so we've gotta cook it to their tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: These dishes won't do at all. First, your heat control's terrible, and second, this stuff doesn't suit our diet. That's gotta change.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: You've still got a lot to learn — I suggest starting from our most basic dishes, like Nod-Krai Hot Dogs. Come back and show me once you're done.

talks.objective: Use the peculiar cooking pot near the lighthouse to make a Nod-Krai Hot Dog

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Mm. The meat's been sliced into sizable chunks, then fried perfectly after that. Not bad.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: But let me remind you. When making fried meat, you must consider your side dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: It's easy to get stuffed from eating too much meat. That's why the berries are there.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Here on this island, we're in charge of everyone's dietary health, so a balance must be struck between vegetables and meat.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: This dish doesn't have enough such veggies on the side. We can't have that here.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: You need to practice more. Come back next time and whip up some Lakkaberry Madame.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Mmm, the sausage is nicely grilled.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: You'd make a half-decent sous chef if you were working in a restaurant outside, I'd say.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: But we're making meals for every Ratnik on this island. So it's not about how fancy the food is, but whether it's plentiful enough.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Make the bread thicker. There's not a ton of vegetables right now, and you could also add some meats apart from sausages.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: You still need more practice! Come back next time and make some Berries and Fried Meat.

talks.objective: Come back to look for the phantom after some time has passed
Use the peculiar cooking pot near the lighthouse to make Berries and Fried Meat
Come back to look for the phantom after some time has passed
Use the peculiar cooking pot near the lighthouse to make Lakkaberry Madame

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: The chicken's flavorful, and there are sufficient side dishes. You tryin' to make it tough for me to nitpick, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: ...Heh. Whatever. Not that I was ever looking to find fault with you newbies specifically.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: I'm just a chef. I just do my job, and I want to do it well.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: And to that end, I made all kinds of preparations for the Wild Hunt's arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: But it's a pity... I couldn't send them the finished dishes in time... The food wound up spilled... spilled...
Ugh. Out of the pot too early... and there's something off about the plating, too...
